notes: Lock single pages: each page has its own padlock (press L), and locked pages are never redesigned, even when you add or remove photos
Easier editing on the spread: guides for equal spacing, select photos across both pages as one group, crop by double-click, and one undo history for edits and views
Page gaps for a single page, spread or story, plus new chat tools so Claude can change gaps, page colour and photo places
Duplicate an album from All albums, reopen the album on the page you left, and pick a second alternative by hand
